data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH sent a reminder because the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee was returned by your bank. €47.40 (€39.90 plus a €7.50 reminder fee) is due by 12 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your gym tried to collect the November 2025 membership fee (€39.90) by direct debit, but your bank returned it. The gym adds a €7.50 fee for the returned debit, so the total is €47.40. Please transfer this amount to the account named in the letter by 12 December 2025. If you have already paid, you can ignore the letter. Check your bank account to see why the debit failed, so future fees are not returned as well. If you think the fee is wrong, contact the gym.
